backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report file with an empty features array, indicating no recorded feature evidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, primary, border, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the True Origin Company LLP frontend app, mounting the React app at the `#root` div and loading `main.tsx`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app shell that sets up TanStack Router routes, a sticky NavBar with mobile hamburger menu and language selector, and renders all page sections and standalone pages like Privacy Policy and Export Certification.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: About section component that renders a checklist, operations list, and vision/mission cards using translated strings from the `useLanguage` context.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with an info panel showing address, phone, and two mailto email links, plus a controlled enquiry form with submission feedback.
frontend/src/components/ExportCargoSecti: Export cargo section displaying a cargo ship image and a three-card highlights grid, with all text rendered via the `useLanguage` translation hook.
frontend/src/components/ExportCertificat: Displays a detailed export certification page listing certifications (APEDA, FSSAI, Organic, etc.), a 6-step quality control process, and per-product specifications with packaging and documentation details for moringa and other exports.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand logo, contact info, quick navigation links, and legal links, supporting smooth-scroll navigation back to homepage sections.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a background image, overlay, localized headline/subheadline, CTA buttons linking to the export certification page and contact section, and a scroll-down indicator.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSelector: Dropdown component allowing users to switch between English, Hindi, and Marathi, using the LanguageContext and adapting its style based on whether the navbar is scrolled.
frontend/src/components/PrivacyPolicyPag: Renders a styled privacy policy page with a header, numbered sections pulled from i18n translations, and a contact callout linking to the company email.
Displays a products grid section featuring moringa powder, curry leaves, fresh vegetables, and custom sourcing, each with an image, icon, and localized title/description, plus a farm image gallery.
frontend/src/components/QualityComplianc: Renders a 'Quality & Compliance' section displaying a grid of certification/documentation items with shield icons, supporting copy, and a CTA button that smooth-scrolls to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/SocialMediaSecti: Renders a social media section with three placeholder video cards (marked 'Coming Soon') and Instagram/YouTube icon links.
frontend/src/components/TermsAndConditio: Renders a full Terms and Conditions page with translated sections, a back-to-home link, and a contact callout footer; scrolls to top on mount.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a React context for multi-language support (English, Hindi, Marathi) with a translation lookup function that falls back to English or the raw key.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and applies Tailwind base/component/utility layers with base typography defaults.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/translations/translations.t: Exports a nested translations object containing English (and other language) string maps keyed by dot-notation identifiers for all UI text across the application.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom design system with Deep Emerald, Soft Gold, and cream color palettes, Playfair Display and Poppins font families, custom shadows, border radii, accordion animations, and plugins for animate, typography, and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state tracker (version 33) for the TrueOrigin Exports marketing website, documenting the site summary, architectural notes (multi-language, nav behavior, page structure), and a list of known UI/rendering bugs to fix.
